scope: Adult-disease review of pulmonary Langerhans cell histiocytosis: smoking, bronchiolar inflammation, cysts, and HRCT.

keyRecommendations.text: Patients are smokers, but the mechanisms by which smoking induces the disease are not known.
Early disease is bronchiolar inflammation; advanced disease has cystic destruction.
HRCT should be obtained in every patient because it can separate PLCH from other cystic lung diseases.

clinicalBottomLine: Think of pulmonary LCH in a smoker with nodules and cysts. Get HRCT. Management depends on whether disease is limited to the lung or is multisystem.
notableCaveats: A paediatric LCH paper was not used. BRAF treatment is not in the sentences used here.
